title: Storybound quest
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/quests/<path>.json — a quest with a state (unknown, active, completed, failed) and stages with objectives.

category.description: Group in the Quests tab; name: '<ns>.quest.category.<path>'. Built in: main, side, contract.

scope.description: Whose progress this is: one player's, the party's (shared by members) or the whole world's.

description.description: Shown above the stage log when 'text' has nothing for the current state.

text.description: Description per state, shown above the stage log.

start.description: Starts the quest for the player when the trigger fires and the conditions pass. Without it, start the quest with set_quest_state or set_quest_stage.

stages.description: In order; the quest starts at the first one.

fail_when.description: Checked every second while the quest is active; when it holds, the quest fails.

on_complete.description: Story effects, run once (for the player who finished the quest).

rewards.description: Run on completion for every online player sharing the quest, so each party member is paid.

notify.description: Show toasts when the quest starts, advances and ends.

log.description: The stage's entry in the quest's story, shown from the moment the stage is reached.

objectives.description: The stage ends when every required objective reaches its count. Without required objectives it waits for set_quest_stage or set_quest_state.

next.description: A stage id, @complete or @fail. Omitted: the following stage, or completion after the last one.

waypoints.description: Static waypoints shown while the quest is at this stage.

id.description: Defaults to the objective's position in the stage.

text.description: The line in the Quests tab and on the HUD; an objective without text is not shown.

optional.description: Counted and shown, but not needed to finish the stage.

hint.description: Optional hint associated with this objective.
